text:
emily: Hi team — FinCloud (EU POC) just sent a vendor risk pack request. They want:
1) an EU-only dataflow diagram (end-to-end)
2) full subprocessor list for EU regions + data residency proofs
3) confirmation that request/response logs and KV caches remain in EU
4) excerpt of KMS key policy / redaction guidance

Can someone own assembling these artifacts? Need to share with their security lead by EOD Thu. Ticket: https://redwood.internal/pocts/4238

rajiv: I can start the subprocessor CSV and a short README. Question: Is this POC on Dedicated EU pool or Hosted? That affects what we can promise for logs.

emily: it's Dedicated EU (customer reserved capacity) — they requested EU-west-1 commitment.

sofia: For SIG/CAIQ they'll want a diagram + controls mapping. We can provide a redacted diagram (no internal hostnames) + signed subproc list. I'll draft the controls mapping. ETA tomorrow afternoon. :+1:

michael: Eng note — runtime currently ships request logs to our central logging cluster (us-west) for hosted by default. For Dedicated we can route logs to customer's EU project and configure retention. Need eng change: set LOG_ROUTING=eu-only for that dedicated tenant.

michael: quick snippet for ops team:
```
# tenant config
TENANT_ID=fincloud-poc
DEPLOY_REGION=eu-west-1
LOG_ROUTING=eu-only
KV_CACHE_PERSIST=local-eu
```

sofia: Also confirm KMS: customer wants a key origin statement. For Dedicated we support customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own). I'll attach sample policy.

rajiv: attaching tentative subproc CSV (will redact partner contact emails):
- aws-eu-west-1 (compute, storage)
- object-storage-eu (s3-compatible backups)
- metrics/analytics (partner: telemetry.co) — optional add-on

emily: Awesome. Can infra-bot create a redacted dataflow diagram export from the VPC topology? Need a diagram PNG + a simplified SVG for their legal.

infra-bot: Deploy-bot triggered: exporting topology for tenant fincloud-poc. ETA ~10m. /logs: https://redwood.internal/logs/4238/export

emily: Perfect. Sofia — when you upload the controls mapping, can you also include the exact CAIQ sections we pass (networking, key mgmt, logging)? That prevents back-and-forth.

sofia: Will do. Also flagging a known blocker: telemetry partner data flow touches a US-based analytics vendor. We'll mark that as 'optional' in the subproc list and provide a pseudonymized dataflow variant that excludes analytics.

michael: If customer insists no third-party telemetry, we can toggle analytics off at the tenant level. No code change required, just deployment flag.

emily: Great. I'll reply to FinCloud with timeline: subproc list + redacted diagram + KMS excerpt + controls mapping by EOD Thu. Thanks all. :pray:
